items.title: Yesterday's VMware vCenter flaw was used as a zero-day by China-linked hackers
items.why: Google and Mandiant say the Armory Castle group exploited the vCenter login bypass since early September to get admin access, forge sign-in tokens and steal data. Broadcom's November 19 builds fix it.
items.action: Install Broadcom's November 19 vCenter fix today (8.0 U3m or newer), keep vCenter off the internet, and have your IT provider check for unknown SSO admin accounts.

items.title: SonicWall says Gen 6 firewalls will get no more patches, even for critical flaws
items.why: SonicWall urges anyone still running Gen 6 models such as the TZ300-TZ600, SOHO 250 and NSA 2600-6600 to replace them now, and expects internet-facing units to be actively targeted.
items.action: Check your firewall model; if it is Gen 6, plan a replacement, and until then turn off WAN management, restrict or disable SSL VPN, require MFA and reset local passwords.

items.title: Attackers exploit a critical Cisco Expressway flaw soon after exploit code went public
items.why: Researchers at F6 saw attackers gain root on internet-facing Expressway devices, then move into the internal network to steal credentials. Cisco released fixes on October 21.
items.action: Update Cisco Expressway to X15.5.20 or later, and ask your IT provider to check the devices for signs of compromise.

items.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard confirm vendor breaches after the n0n gang leaks data
items.why: All three say outside service providers were hit and that marketing data such as customer emails was exposed, not card numbers. The gang has posted the data for download.
items.action: Expect phishing that uses these bank and card brands, and remind staff to reach their bank only through its app or the number on the card.

items.title: N-able says credentials may have been taken in its Mail Assure hack; portal still down
items.why: N-able says an intruder on one web server may have accessed stored credentials. It revoked customer API tokens and OAuth tokens and reset local passwords; mail filtering still works.
items.action: If you or your MSP use Mail Assure or SpamExperts, follow N-able's guidance, reissue API tokens and change any passwords that were stored on the platform.

items.title: Unpatched Windows 'FastUnlock' trick runs programs on a locked PC
items.why: A researcher showed that someone holding a locked Windows computer can start programs from the lock screen in a limited account. There is no fix yet and no attacks seen.
items.action: Add a BitLocker startup PIN on laptops that travel, and shut down or hibernate them rather than just locking the screen when they leave your hands.
